title: See the Hostility Behind the Friendly Facade: The Law of Aggression
coreMove: Treat friendly obstruction as an aggression pattern and answer with clear boundaries, documentation, and controlled force.
sourcePressure: This law studies hostile force wearing civilized clothing: delay, ambiguity, moral pose, and passive resistance can preserve plausible deniability while causing damage.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Calling every difficult person aggressive instead of identifying repeated damage hidden behind politeness or ambiguity.

sourceAnchors.name: John D. Rockefeller
